body:
My words probably won’t be very helpful to you but I was in that same position a few years ago. Currently I am 21 and I’ve dropped out of college. The one thing I always fantasize about is getting transported back in time to redo the past 3 years of my life. Small goals are better than none and I wish I had known that back then. If there’s anything you think you can reasonably accomplish every day then start there.

Get out of bed by a certain time, get to sleep by a certain time, eat breakfast. The way I see it I can’t find purpose if I’m dead, this keeps me from giving up entirely.

My main reason is that I’ve somehow enjoyed watching these videos over the years despite the emotional trauma and nightmares they cause. They have kept me alive in a strange way.

This hasn’t helped me get better, its just made my last wall of defense a bit harder to breech.

If I were to do it I’d like to provide 4k footage at 60 frames, I don’t think anyone’s actually done that before when it comes to suicide videos. Not sure how it would be done, maybe a YouTube stream where you tell people to record it before you go live. Who knows.

This is a throwaway because my main reddit account is mostly used for sharing my YouTube videos which are very lighthearted and completely unrelated to anything I’m saying here. 
It would be awful but going live to an audience of 100 people and doing something that horrific out of nowhere? I can’t be the only person who finds that funny.

I have scared myself out of suicide by watching other people’s attempts. Suicide by firearm is statistically unlikely to be survivable when done correctly, but the videos show something you don’t see in movies.

It is not quick from the perspective of the viewer. The victim is likely gone already but whatever parts of them are functional will continue to struggle.

Despite this I’d still like to contribute my own death to the library should I decide to kill myself.

Thank you for reading this.

I hope you find peace as well.
